Every six months the dragon Nimmersatt gets distracted and players can invade his lair, northwest of Carlin. The goal is to collect {item:Snowball|Snowballs} in the north of the dungeon and throw them at the {item:Lava Wall} next to the entrance until it comes down. The reward is a chance to get the {item:Bottled Dragon Breath}, which is needed for the {wiki:Dragon Slayer Outfits} made by {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}.
Only during the event (raid), which happens every 6 months.
Nothing special: the {item:Snowball|Snowballs} are picked up inside the dungeon.
Chance to get the {item:Bottled Dragon Breath}, needed for the {wiki:Dragon Slayer Outfits} from {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}.
Dragon Slayer Outfits (the Bottled Dragon Breath is required)
If you get the {item:Bottled Dragon Breath} at the event, take it to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} for the {wiki:Dragon Slayer Outfits}.
It is only a chance of getting the bottle; the event happens every 6 months.
Keep an eye out for the raid messages: the announcement repeats every 15 minutes until the wall falls.

The {creature:Dragon Bride|Dragon Brides} look like {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons}, but they are not as dangerous as them. They can, however, leave you feared ({wiki:Feared|fear}), drunk ({wiki:Drunk|drunk}) or frozen ({wiki:Rooted|rooted}).

The event starts with the message *"The dragon Nimmersatt is distracted! Help to breach its lair! Join the heist at the coast north of Carlin!"*, which repeats every **15 minutes** until the wall is destroyed. The lair is northwest of Carlin.
The {wiki:Tibia Observer} lists the location as {wiki:Ice Islands} (Carlin).

Leave Carlin through the **north** and go to the north coast of the city ({coord:32259,31642,7}). Talk to {npc:Rascalio}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}. While the event is active, he takes you to the island of Banor's Eye, where Nimmersatt's lair is (northwest of Carlin, in the {wiki:Ice Islands} area).
Rascalio only makes this trip while the Nimmersatt's Lair event is active.
Go to the **north** of the dungeon and pick up {item:Snowball|Snowballs}.
On the way there are {creature:Dragon Bride|Dragon Brides}. They use area abilities around them that cause fear, drunkenness and freezing.
Throwing the Snowballs at the wall
Go back to the {item:Lava Wall} near the entrance and throw the Snowballs at it (use them on the wall). Each one does it some damage. Repeat until the wall falls.
When the wall is destroyed the message *"Nimmersatts lair is opened! The heist has ended!"* appears. The lair stays open and you have a chance to obtain the {item:Bottled Dragon Breath}.
Chance to get the {item:Bottled Dragon Breath}

The lair is on an island, so there is no way back on foot. Return to the entrance area (next to the {item:Lava Wall}) and look for {npc:Rascalio}: the ferryman also appears in the {wiki:Ice Islands}, next to the lair. Ask him for passage back to Carlin's north coast (start with {key:hi} and {key:passage}). The wiki does not detail the trip back; if you cannot find him, use a teleport method to the temple, such as a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}.
The time of the last message depends on how quickly the players bring the wall down.
Take the {item:Bottled Dragon Breath} to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} for the {wiki:Dragon Slayer Outfits}.
